articles.summary: HARTFORD, Conn., Sept. 28, 2026 The Hartford will release its third quarter 2026 financial results at approximately 4:05 p.m. EDT on Monday, Oct. 26. The company will host a webcast at 9 a.m. EDT on Tuesday, Oct. 27 to discuss the results. The webcast will be available on the investor relations section of the companys website, https://ir.thehartford.com, and will be made available for replay, along with a transcript of the event, for at least one year. About The Hartford The Hartford is a leader in property and casualty insurance and employee benefits. By anticipating challenges and reducing risks our customers face, the company helps people and businesses thrive with confidence. Built on a foundation of trust, The Hartford is committed to strong performance, exceptional customer experiences and bold innovation, hallmarks of its sustained success since 1810. articles.summary: HARTFORD, Conn., Sept. 3, 2026 The Hartfords Chief Financial Officer Beth Costello will participate in a fireside chat at the 2026 KBW Insurance Conference at approximately 8:20 a.m. on Thursday, Sept. 10. A webcast of the event will be made available, along with a replay, for at least 90 days following the event at https://ir.thehartford.com . About The Hartford The Hartford is a leader in property and casualty insurance and employee benefits. By anticipating challenges and reducing risks our customers face, the company helps people and businesses thrive with confidence.
